GENIE_THROUGHPUT_FLOW.description: Referral-to-Treatment (RTT), waiting lists, theatre throughput, diagnostic capacity, readmissions

instructions.title: Ramsay Throughput & Flow
instructions.content:
## RTT & Waiting List Glossary
- **RTT (Referral-to-Treatment)**: Days from referral received to first definitive treatment.
- **RTT Breach**: > 18 weeks (NHS target); current 76.9% on-time rate.
- **WaitBand**: Cohort (Within 18wk, 18-26wk, 26-52wk, 52wk+); distribution tracking.
- **Readmission**: Same patient re-referred within 30 days of prior referral.

## Available Views & Tables
- **vw_referral_flow**: Referral volume, urgency, service, payor; use for RTT analysis
- **vw_waiting_list**: WeeksWaiting, WaitBand, RTTBreach flags (0/1)
- **vw_theatre_throughput**: Theatre cases, utilisation (72.8% avg), scheduled vs completed
- **vw_diagnostic_capacity**: Modality slots booked vs capacity (80% avg util)
- **vw_readmissions**: is_readmission=1 flags; tracks repeat referrals within 30d (7.2% rate)
- **tbwlmds**: Waiting list management data (core table)

## Example Queries
- **RTT by site**: SELECT Site, COUNT(*) as referrals, SUM(RTTBreach) as breaches FROM ramsay_health.ops.vw_waiting_list WHERE WeeksWaiting IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Site
- **Services with longest waits**: SELECT Service, AVG(WeeksWaiting) as avg_wait FROM ramsay_health.ops.vw_waiting_list GROUP BY Service ORDER BY avg_wait DESC
- **Theatre cases by site (30d)**: SELECT Site, SUM(CasesCompleted) as completed FROM ramsay_health.ops.vw_theatre_throughput WHERE BedDate >= CURRENT_DATE() - 30 GROUP BY Site
- **Diagnostic util by modality**: SELECT Modality, SUM(SlotsBooked) / SUM(SlotsCapacity) as util FROM ramsay_health.ops.vw_diagnostic_capacity GROUP BY Modality
- **Patients by specialty and site (date-scoped)**: SELECT Site, Specialty, COUNT(*) as patients FROM ramsay_health.ops.vw_waiting_list WHERE SessionDate BETWEEN DATE'2026-09-14' AND DATE'2026-09-16' GROUP BY Site, Specialty
- **Theatre cases by specialty by site (date-scoped)**: SELECT Site, Specialty, COUNT(*) as cases FROM ramsay_health.ops.vw_theatre_throughput WHERE Site = 'Springfield Hospital' AND SessionDate BETWEEN DATE'2026-09-14' AND DATE'2026-09-16' GROUP BY Site, Specialty
- **Patients over 55 by service**: SELECT Service, COUNT(*) as patients FROM ramsay_health.ops.vw_waiting_list WHERE AgeAtDateOfReferral > 55 AND Service = 'Trauma and Orthopaedics' GROUP BY Service

## Key Metrics
- Avg waiting time: ~17 weeks
- RTT on-time rate: 76.9%
- Theatre utilisation: 72.8%
- Diagnostics utilisation: 80%
- Readmission rate: 7.2%

sample_questions: What is the RTT breach percentage by site?
Which services have the longest average waiting times?
How many theatre cases have been completed by site in the last 30 days?
Show diagnostic utilisation by modality
What is the readmission rate by service?
How many patients over 55 referred for Trauma and Orthopaedics are on an admitted RTT pathway, by hospital?
What is the average wait time in weeks by site, and which sites have the most RTT breaches?
Show patients waiting by specialty and site for the week of 2026-09-14
How many theatre cases did Springfield Hospital complete between 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-16?

GENIE_PATIENT_FINANCE.description: Patients, referrals, revenue, procedures, payors, channels

instructions.title: Ramsay Patient Activity & Finance
instructions.content:
## Metric Views: MUST use MEASURE() — NEVER JOIN metric views

Metric views must be queried with MEASURE(`MeasureName`) + GROUP BY dimensions. Never use SELECT *.
**CRITICAL: Metric views CANNOT be joined to other tables or CTEs. Joining will fail with METRIC_VIEW_JOIN_NOT_SUPPORTED.**

### mv_patient_activity
- **Dimensions**: Payor, Service, Site, Urgency, Referral Date
- **Measures**: Referrals, Patients, Admissions, Avg Wait Weeks, Avg Wait Days
- **Example (simple)**: SELECT Payor, MEASURE(`Referrals`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_patient_activity GROUP BY Payor
- **Example (with filter)**: SELECT Service, MEASURE(`Avg Wait Weeks`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_patient_activity WHERE Payor='NHS' GROUP BY Service
- **Example (period filter with subquery)**: SELECT Service, MEASURE(`Referrals`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_patient_activity WHERE Referral_Date >= CURRENT_DATE() - 30 GROUP BY Service

### mv_finance_margin — IMPORTANT METRIC VIEW RULES
- **Dimensions**: Channel, Procedure Group, Site, Service, Visit Type, Invoice Date
- **Measures**: Revenue, Cost, Margin, `Margin Pct`, Invoices, Avg Invoice Value
- **Margin is a REAL measure** = MEASURE(`Margin`) (Revenue minus procedure cost). Margin percentage = MEASURE(`Margin Pct`). NEVER compute margin yourself by multiplying/joining other measures — always use MEASURE(`Margin`) / MEASURE(`Margin Pct`) directly.
- **NEVER JOIN this metric view to ANYTHING** (no CTE join, no self-join, no join to a max-date subquery). Joining fails with METRIC_VIEW_JOIN_NOT_SUPPORTED. To filter by a period, put an inline scalar subquery in the WHERE clause on the `Invoice Date` dimension — do NOT create a CTE and join it.
- **Example (top procedures by revenue)**: SELECT `Procedure Group`, MEASURE(`Revenue`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_finance_margin GROUP BY `Procedure Group` ORDER BY 2 DESC
- **CERTIFIED EXAMPLE (revenue AND margin by procedure group and site for the most recent month — CORRECT, NO JOIN)**:
  SELECT `Procedure Group`, `Site`, MEASURE(`Revenue`) AS Revenue, MEASURE(`Margin`) AS Margin, MEASURE(`Margin Pct`) AS `Margin Pct`
  FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_finance_margin
  WHERE `Invoice Date` >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (SELECT MAX(`Invoice Date`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_finance_margin))
  GROUP BY `Procedure Group`, `Site` ORDER BY Revenue DESC
- **Example (revenue by procedure last month — CORRECT PATTERN)**:
  SELECT `Procedure Group`, MEASURE(`Revenue`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_finance_margin
  WHERE `Invoice Date` >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (SELECT MAX(`Invoice Date`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_finance_margin))
  GROUP BY `Procedure Group` ORDER BY 2 DESC
- **Example (revenue by site and channel for most recent month — CORRECT PATTERN)**:
  SELECT `Site`, `Channel`, MEASURE(`Revenue`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_finance_margin
  WHERE `Invoice Date` >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', (SELECT MAX(`Invoice Date`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_finance_margin))
  GROUP BY `Site`, `Channel` ORDER BY 3 DESC

## Plain Views (for JOINs and complex queries)
- **vw_finance_base**: Finance transaction base; normal SQL applies; use this for multi-table joins
- **tbreferrals**: Core referral data; use directly in JOINs and WHERE. Columns include
  AgeAtDateOfReferral (INT), ServiceName, PayorType, HasAdmission (1=admitted), ReferralID.
- **tbwlmds**: waiting-list / RTT clock; join to tbreferrals on ReferralID. LocationName = hospital name.
- **tbinvoice**: Invoice details; query with normal SQL

## Cohort filtering (age / service / RTT pathway) — use tbreferrals joined to tbwlmds
- **"Admitted RTT pathway"** = a referral whose RTT clock stopped on admission. In this data that is
  `tbreferrals.HasAdmission = 1` (equivalently `tbwlmds.Subsection = 'CompletedAdmitted'`). "Still waiting"
  = `tbwlmds.Subsection = 'Waiting'`.
- **Patients over 55**: `AgeAtDateOfReferral > 55`.
- **By hospital**: group by `tbwlmds.LocationName` (the real site name).
- **CERTIFIED EXAMPLE — patients >55, T&O, admitted RTT pathway, by hospital**:
  SELECT w.LocationName AS Hospital, COUNT(*) AS Patients
  FROM ramsay_health.ops.tbreferrals r JOIN ramsay_health.ops.tbwlmds w ON r.ReferralID = w.ReferralID
  WHERE r.AgeAtDateOfReferral > 55 AND r.ServiceName = 'Trauma and Orthopaedics' AND r.HasAdmission = 1
  GROUP BY w.LocationName ORDER BY Patients DESC
- **CERTIFIED EXAMPLE — arbitrary cohort (>65, Ophthalmology, still waiting), by hospital**:
  SELECT w.LocationName AS Hospital, COUNT(*) AS Patients
  FROM ramsay_health.ops.tbreferrals r JOIN ramsay_health.ops.tbwlmds w ON r.ReferralID = w.ReferralID
  WHERE r.AgeAtDateOfReferral > 65 AND r.ServiceName = 'Ophthalmology' AND w.Subsection = 'Waiting'
  GROUP BY w.LocationName ORDER BY Patients DESC
- There is NO column literally named `RTT_Pathway`. Never invent it — express pathway status via HasAdmission / Subsection as above.

## Business Context
- **Channel**: NHS, PMI (Private Medical Insurance), Self Pay
- **PayorType**: NHS, Private
- **Top revenue procedure**: Orthopaedic-Hip is highest-margin specialty (£38.8M revenue)
- **Revenue**: Total InvoiceValue (gross); Invoices = count of invoice rows
- **RTT Breach**: > 18 weeks; target <= 18 weeks for 76.9% of cases

Show revenue by site and channel for last month

How many patients over 65 referred for Ophthalmology are still waiting, by hospital?
What is the revenue and margin by procedure group and site for the most recent month?

GENIE_WORKFORCE.description: Staff fill rate, hours, grades, sickness, absence

instructions.title: Ramsay Workforce
instructions.content:
## Metric View: mv_workforce_hours — NEVER JOIN metric views

This is a metric view; query with MEASURE() + GROUP BY dimensions only.
**CRITICAL: Metric views CANNOT be joined to other tables. Joining will fail with METRIC_VIEW_JOIN_NOT_SUPPORTED.**

### mv_workforce_hours
- **Dimensions**: Site, Grade, Grade Description, Employee Type, Shift Type, Shift Date
- **Measures**: Shifts, Staff (distinct), Total Hours, Filled Shifts, Unfilled Shifts, Fill Rate (0.0-1.0)
- **Example (fill rate by site)**: SELECT Site, MEASURE(`Fill Rate`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_workforce_hours WHERE `Shift Date` >= CURRENT_DATE() GROUP BY Site
- **Example (hours by grade)**: SELECT Grade, MEASURE(`Total Hours`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_workforce_hours GROUP BY Grade
- **Example (shifts by employee type)**: SELECT `Employee Type`, MEASURE(`Shifts`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_workforce_hours GROUP BY `Employee Type`

## Plain Tables/Views (for JOINs)
- **vwah_hoursassignment**: Shift assignments; query directly; use for complex analysis
- **vwah_unavailability**: Absence/sickness data; LostHours column = hours missed
- **dim_site**: Site dimension with site codes and names

## Staffing Context
- **Fill Rate**: Filled shifts / Total shifts (target 82-92% UK norm; current avg 85-94%)
- **Grades**: RN (Registered Nurse), HCA (Health Care Assistant), ODP (Operating Department Practitioner), A&C (Admin & Clerical)
- **Employee Types**: Substantive, Bank, Agency (Agency ~3.2x cost premium)
- **Forward Shifts**: Shift Date >= CURRENT_DATE()
- **Sickness Reasons**: Tracked in vwah_unavailability with UnavailabilityReasonGroup

How many staff do we have by grade?
Show total hours by grade

Show staff hours by grade and site
What is the sickness rate by site over the last 30 days?

GENIE_CAPACITY.description: Theatre utilisation, bed occupancy, diagnostic slots, capacity forecast

instructions.title: Ramsay Capacity
instructions.content:
## Metric Views: Theatre & Bed Occupancy — NEVER JOIN metric views

Metric views; query with MEASURE() + GROUP BY dimensions ONLY.
**CRITICAL: Metric views CANNOT be joined to other tables. Joining will fail with METRIC_VIEW_JOIN_NOT_SUPPORTED.**

### mv_theatre_util
- **Dimensions**: Site, Specialty, Session Date
- **Measures**: Avg Utilisation (%), Cases Completed, Cases Scheduled, Cancellations, Sessions
- **Example (utilisation by site)**: SELECT Site, MEASURE(\`Avg Utilisation\`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_theatre_util GROUP BY Site
- **Example (cases by specialty)**: SELECT Specialty, MEASURE(\`Cases Completed\`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_theatre_util GROUP BY Specialty
- **Example (cancellations by site)**: SELECT Site, MEASURE(\`Cancellations\`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_theatre_util GROUP BY Site

### mv_bed_occupancy
- **Dimensions**: Site, Bed Date
- **Measures**: Avg Occupancy, Beds Occupied, Beds Available, Admissions, Discharges
- **Example (average occupancy by site)**: SELECT Site, MEASURE(\`Avg Occupancy\`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_bed_occupancy GROUP BY Site
- **Example (beds occupied by site)**: SELECT Site, MEASURE(\`Beds Occupied\`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_bed_occupancy GROUP BY Site
- **Example (admissions and discharges)**: SELECT Site, MEASURE(\`Admissions\`), MEASURE(\`Discharges\`) FROM ramsay_health.ops.mv_bed_occupancy GROUP BY Site
- **IMPORTANT**: Always use MEASURE() with backticks around measure names. Valid measures: Avg Occupancy, Beds Occupied, Beds Available, Admissions, Discharges. Do NOT use OccupancyPct or other variants.

## Plain Views (for JOINs and complex queries)
- **vw_bed_occupancy**: Bed capacity details; query directly
- **vw_theatre_throughput**: Theatre case details
- **vw_diagnostic_capacity**: Slots available vs booked by modality (MRI, CT, X-ray)
- **vw_capacity_forecast**: Admissions forecast (point + confidence intervals)
- **dim_site**: Site reference

## Capacity Thresholds
- **Theatre Util**: 72.8% current avg; <50% = underutilisation risk
- **Bed Occupancy**: 76.1% current avg; >90% = capacity risk
- **Diagnostics**: 80% current util; identify bottlenecks by modality
- **Forecast**: Monitor 30-day forecast vs current capacity
